import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.next();
        StringBuilder ans = new StringBuilder();
        int i = 0;
        int flag = 0;

        while (i < s.length()) {
            if (s.charAt(i) == 'd') {
                if (i + 2 < s.length() && s.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                    ans.append('.');
                    i += 3;
                } else {
                    ans.append(s.charAt(i));
                    i++;
                }
            } else if (s.charAt(i) == 'a' && i + 1 < s.length() && s.charAt(i + 1) == 't') {
                ans.append('@');
                i += 2;
            } else {
                ans.append(s.charAt(i));
                i++;
            }
        }

        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();

        if (ans.length() > 0) {
            char firstChar = ans.charAt(0);
            if (firstChar == '.') {
                result.append("dot");
            } else if (firstChar == '@') {
                result.append("at");
            } else {
                result.append(firstChar);
            }
        }

        for (i = 1; i < ans.length() - 1; i++) {
            char c = ans.charAt(i);
            if (c == '@' && flag == 0) {
                result.append(c);
                flag = 1;
            } else if (c == '@' && flag == 1) {
                result.append("at");
            } else {
                result.append(c);
            }
        }

        if (ans.length() > 0) {
            char lastChar = ans.charAt(ans.length() - 1);
            if (lastChar == '.') {
                result.append("dot");
            } else if (lastChar == '@') {
                result.append("at");
            } else {
                result.append(lastChar);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(result.toString());
        sc.close();
    }
}
